_comment: BARE STRUCTURAL template (Tony 2026-08-24): floors + blocks only. Id 0 = role disabled — no faces, corners, caps or doors are emitted; the builder derives nothing (no offset strips: N/W of a mass is void unless floor is drawn there). Copy this file or save a style from the sketcher, then set real ground/structural ids. Doors are forbidden in bare builds — connectivity is open gaps.
